idea-plugin.name: OpenCode ASP
idea-plugin.description:
OpenCode ASP - OpenCode Android Studio Plugin

Seamlessly integrate OpenCode, the open-source AI coding agent, into your Android Studio workflow.

Key Features

  • Quick Launch: Connect to an existing OpenCode server, including OpenCode Desktop, or start a local terminal with Cmd+Esc / Ctrl+\. Authentication is detected automatically when available; enter a server password when required and optionally save it in the IDE Password Safe.
  • Context Sharing: Send the current file, selected code, or Project View files to OpenCode with Opt+Cmd+K / Ctrl+Alt+K.
  • Native Diff Review: Review AI-generated changes across multiple files in the IDE. Accept a change to write and stage it with git add, or reject it to restore the previous content. Local History snapshots provide an additional recovery path.
  • Task Notifications: Get notified when an OpenCode task finishes.
  • Session Resume: Continue your recent OpenCode session when starting a terminal.
  • Smart File Links: Open file references such as @src/Main.kt#L10-20 directly in the editor.

Getting Started

  1. Install OpenCode CLI (for example, with npm install -g opencode-ai) and Git.
  2. Press Cmd+Esc on macOS or Ctrl+\ on Windows/Linux to open the connection dialog.
  3. Connect to an existing server or start a local session. OpenCode CLI v2 requires a server password.
  4. Use Opt+Cmd+K / Ctrl+Alt+K to send code context to OpenCode.

Requires Android Studio 2025.2 or later and the bundled Terminal plugin. See the project documentation for setup details.
